The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6e7116ea33f29ee), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let F : H → C be univalent and admit a continuous extension to H with values in the sphere. Suppose a continuous path η in H starts at 0, reaches modulus 1, and satisfies F(η) ⊂ B(q, r), where r > 0. There exist b, c, C > 0 and L0 > 1, depending only on κ, such that for every L ≥ L0, ordinary chordal SLE satisfies P {F(γ[0, σLb ]) ̸⊂ B(q, Lr)} ≤ CL−c , σA = inf{t : |γ(t)| = A}. If the modulus stop is not reached, use the entire future trace. All four constants are independent of F, q, r, and of the path η. Boundary excursions are included.
